stages.title: Engine: start, resume, journey
stages.notes: Deliver U0 per docs/CONDUCTOR-UX.md (U0.1 discovery, U0.2 journey verb, U0.3 gateless + resume docs). All C# engine work, no Face changes. REUSE: PlanSettings.ResolvePlanPath is the single ingress every verb shares — extend it there only. Spectre SelectionPrompt only when Console interactive. journey is a NEW Spectre verb registered in Program.cs (escape [ as [[ in descriptions — top-level help renders them as markup). Gateless: gates:[] must produce 'gates green (none configured)' verdicts; prove with a fake-agent scratch test (tools/fake-agent.ps1 pattern, see .claude/skills/run-conductor/driver.ps1 for scaffolding). Unit tests for resolution order + journey human-moments extraction. Gate: full suite green.

stages.title: Face: landing page + workspace identity
stages.notes: Deliver U1 per docs/CONDUCTOR-UX.md (U1.1 Home tab, U1.2 workspace in the top bar). Go/bubbletea v2 work in face-go. Home is a NEW first tab (key h), the startup tab, replacing the splash as landing; panels Server/Run/Workspace/Next-steps fed entirely from /state + /plan (StateDto.Repo and PlanDir already exist). Demo source must fill every field. Tab arrays in model.go are fixed-size — grow tabCount/tabNames/tabKey together and update renderHelpOverlay. Golden frames for Home (connected, disconnected, demo) + updated bar goldens. go test ./... green including goldens.

stages.title: Face: controls, visual report, dev stats
stages.notes: Deliver U2 per docs/CONDUCTOR-UX.md (U2.1 grouped palette + promptable danger, U2.2 visual Report tab, U2.3 Dev tab with the SQL console + per-session stats). The SQL console CODE MOVES from tab_report.go to the new Dev tab largely unchanged — keep its tests. Report renders from /state + /sessions; if per-session token columns are missing from SessionRowDto, extend GET /sessions in ControlPlaneServer (run.db sessions table already stores tokens) and mirror in api/types.go + demo. Danger verbs: kill/abort/rollback red + confirm naming consequences; no destructive action without y/N. Goldens for palette overlay, Report, Dev.

stages.title: Face: themes, agent-terminal vibe, glitch pass
stages.notes: Deliver U3 per docs/CONDUCTOR-UX.md (U3.1 themes mocha/latte/nord/gruvbox with ApplyTheme + --theme flag + persisted config + palette verb; U3.2 the golden glitch pass at 132x40, 100x30, 80x24 seeded from the spec's dogfood appendix; U3.3 agent-terminal vibe — transcript presentation modeled on Claude Code first / opencode second, provider-aware via agent.provider on the wire, collapsed thinking, session footer strip). Theme switch rebuilds package style vars in widgets AND tui — one rebuild func per package, called at startup and on switch; goldens pin mocha. go test ./... green; STYLE.md updated.
